column1: ICC-ES Evaluation Report ESR-2236 (Reissued January 2026, Revised March 2026 w/ 2026 LABC/LARC Supplement) – Simpson Strong-Drive SDS Heavy-Duty Connector Screws
Footnotes & Geometry Requirements (ICC-ES ESR-2236 Tables 1, 2, 3, 4A, 4B, and 5):

column2: Head diameter (integral washer) D_H = 0.500 in.; 3/8-in. hex drive; tip length L_tip = 0.334 in. (Type 17 drill point). Installed without predrilling.

Length of thread L_thread includes the tip. For NDS withdrawal calculations (Section 4.1.3), SDS screws are classified as a No. 14 wood screw (W = 172 lbf/in. for G = 0.50 DF-L; W = 121 lbf/in. for G = 0.42 SPF).

Table 2 (Steel-to-Wood): Side member must be steel with Fu >= 45 ksi for 16 ga (0.0584 in.) to 7 ga (0.1795 in.) and Fu >= 52 ksi for 3 ga (0.2405 in.). Main wood member must have SG_NDS >= 0.50 (e.g., Douglas Fir-Larch or Southern Pine) or SCL with SG_eq >= 0.50, and thickness t_m >= L - t_s,s.
Table 3 (Wood-to-Wood): Wood side member actual thickness t_s,w must be 1-1/2 in. or 1-3/4 in., and main wood member thickness t_m >= L - t_s,w with SG_NDS >= 0.50.

Table 4A (Connection Geometry for Tested Values in Tables 2 & 3): Edge distance = 1-1/2 in. (perp to grain) or 1 in. (parallel to grain); End distance = 4 in. (perp) or 3 in. (parallel); Spacing in a row = 3 in.; Spacing between rows = 3 in. (1-1/2 in. for staggered rows).

Table 4B (Connection Geometry for NDS Yield Limit Calculations per Sec. 4.1.5 & 4.1.6): Use D_r = 0.188 in. in NDS Tables 12.3.1A/B and 12.3.3, L_m = p - 0.5*L_tip, and F_e,steel = 1.375*F_u. For SG_NDS >= 0.50: Edge = 1-1/2 in. (perp) / 1 in. (par); End = 3-3/4 in. (perp) / 3 in. (par); Spacing in row = 1-3/4 in. (perp) / 3 in. (par); Row spacing = 2-1/2 in. (perp) / 1-3/4 in. (par).

Section 5.3 Condition of Use: When connection capacity is controlled by fastener steel strength (N_a, V_a, N_u, V_u) or metal side plate strength rather than wood strength, the allowable strength shall NOT be multiplied by NDS adjustment factors (such as C_D).
